sentences.en: If you want to keep meat for long, freeze it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想长时间保存肉食，请将其冷冻。

sentences.en: When water freezes and becomes solid, we call it ice.
sentences.zh: 当水冻结成固体时，我们称之为冰。

sentences.en: The union bosses are fighting the freeze on wage hikes.
sentences.zh: 工会领导层正在反对工资上涨的冻结。

senses.zh: （使）冻结，结冰；严寒；（水管等）冻住；冷冻，冷藏；惊呆；使定格；（账户）冻结；僵硬
